versions.subject: Merge PR #4938 from @frack113 - Add CVE-2024-37085 detection rules
versions.detection:
selection_net_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\net.exe'
          - '\net1.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'net.exe'
          - 'net1.exe'
selection_net_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/add'
        - '/domain'
        - 'ESX Admins'
        - 'group'
selection_powershell_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\PowerShell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'PowerShell.exe'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_powershell_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'New-ADGroup'
        - 'ESX Admins'
condition: all of selection_net_* or all of selection_powershell_*
versions.spl: (Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("net.exe", "net1.exe") CommandLine="*/add*" CommandLine="*/domain*" CommandLine="*ESX Admins*" CommandLine="*group*") OR (Image IN ("*\\PowerShell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.exe", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine="*New-ADGroup*" CommandLine="*ESX Admins*")
